description: One ad in full by its id from `ads_search`, with the facts its library shows only on the single ad (for example the countries it ran in). Costs $0.006 when found; an unknown id is free, and a library that cannot be read right now answers 503 (free). While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

id.description: The ad id from an `ads_search` result, such as `google.AR0123456789.CR0123456789`.

name: ad_get
title: Get Ad
